scope: Greene County NY legal-notice channel audit (county-hosted + newspaper-of-record + statewide aggregator + Column)
headline_finding: Current Column adapter under-reports by ~35x due to a one-character filter mismatch: filter value 'Greene' returns 76 mis-tagged Kingston Daily Freeman notices (0 with Greene-property attachment); filter value 'Greene County' returns 35 Catskill Daily Mail distress notices (30 Foreclosure Sale + 4 Summons + 1 Estate Probate) in the same 90-day window.

channels.name: Column / eNotice (newyork.column.us, catskilldailymail.column.us, hudsonregisterstar.column.us)
channels.rationale: Column is the technology vendor that powers statutory legal-notice publishing for many NY newspapers including the Catskill Daily Mail (Greene County's newspaper of record under NY Gen Construction Law and county designations). Notices placed here are legally-sufficient publications of record.
publication_subdomains_for_greene: https://catskilldailymail.column.us/  (Catskill Daily Mail — Greene County newspaper of record)
https://hudsonregisterstar.column.us/ (Hudson Register Star — Columbia County primary, but cross-published Greene matter)

filter_semantics_critical.county_field_is: publishing/service county of the newspaper, NOT the property's county
filter_semantics_critical.bug_in_current_adapter: scrapers/legal_notices_column.py passes county=['Greene'] which matches Kingston Daily Freeman tags but NOT the canonical Catskill Daily Mail tag 'Greene County'. The 76 hits with county='Greene' are Kingston/Ulster notices with zero Greene-property attachment.

distress_doc_types_carried: Foreclosure Sale (mortgage foreclosure NOS / referee sale combined)
Tax foreclosure (rare here — county runs its own auction process via Absolute Auctions and a scanned petition PDF; Column carries Notice of Sale class)
channels.remediation_one_liner: In scrapers/legal_notices_column.py change PUBLISHING_COUNTIES = ['Greene', 'Albany', ...] to ['Greene County', 'Albany County', ...] OR drop the county filter and instead filter on newspapername in ['Catskill Daily Mail', 'Hudson Valley 360 / Register Star', 'Ravena News-Herald'] plus require Greene-property markers in text. Either fix lifts 90d yield from 1 to ~35 distress notices.
channels.secondary_remediation: noticetype field is rich enough to classify directly: 'Foreclosure Sale', 'Notice of Sale', 'Estate (Probate) Filings', 'Summons'. Adapter currently re-derives via regex; using noticetype as primary signal cuts misclassification.

channels.name: Greene County Treasurer — Annual Petition and Notice of Foreclosure (county-hosted PDF)
channels.rationale: Posted by the County Treasurer per Real Property Tax Law Article 11 (tax-foreclosure proceeding initiated by the county). This IS the in-rem tax-foreclosure petition list.
distress_doc_types_carried: Tax-foreclosure petition (RPTL Article 11) — annual list of parcels facing in-rem tax foreclosure
channels.extraction_path: stdlib urllib download -> pdftotext (returns 0 bytes) -> OCR (tesseract/textract/pdfplumber+OCR) -> parcel/owner/SBL table extraction
channels.annual_cadence: Posted yearly under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/04/  — file naming convention 'YYYY-Petition-and-Notice-of-Forclosure.pdf' (note: county uses misspelled 'Forclosure'). Date pattern: April.
channels.redemption_deadline_typical: April publication, statutory October expiration of redemption period under RPTL 1110.

channels.name: Greene County Treasurer — annual Tax-Foreclosed Real Estate Online Auction (via Absolute Auctions & Realty / NYSAuctions / Auctions International)
channels.rationale: Run by the County Treasurer post in-rem; properties have already been county-deeded and are being disposed. Auction catalog is the canonical roster of tax-foreclosed property going to sale.
primary_urls: https://nysauctions.com/  (Absolute Auctions & Realty / AAR — NY tax-foreclosure auctioneer used by Greene)
channels.current_status: AAR/NYSAuctions is already the source backing the existing 50-real-lead Phase-3 dataset per commit c3d7469. Operator-verified.
distress_doc_types_carried: Tax-foreclosed real estate auction catalog (county-deeded parcels)

channels.name: Greene County government — /category/notices/ WordPress feed
channels.rationale: County's own WordPress notices category. Carries county-issued legal notices (RFPs, hearings, organizational meetings, construction projects). Distress notices are sparse here.
channels.category_volume: 161 pages of notices (most are non-distress: meetings, RFPs, hearings, planning, HUD PAR reports)
distress_doc_types_carried: Tax-foreclosure auction announcement (annual, pointed at AAR/NYSAuctions)
Vehicle/equipment surplus auction notices (occasional, via Auctions International)
channels.value_assessment: Reference-only for distress in practice — distress content is announcement-level and points at the AAR/NYSAuctions auction or the Treasurer's PDF petition, both of which are already higher-resolution sources. Worth scraping for the *event ping* (auction date + AAR catalog URL) but NOT as a primary parcel-event source.

channels.name: Hudson Valley 360 / Catskill Daily Mail / Register Star (Hometown News group, redirected to Daily Gazette infrastructure)
channels.rationale: Catskill Daily Mail is Greene County's designated newspaper of record. Daily Mail and Register Star (Columbia County) operate jointly. Their public-notices section now redirects through dailygazette.com hosting.
primary_urls: https://catskilldailymail.column.us/place  (notice placement portal — confirms Daily Mail is on Column)
channels.key_finding: Hudson Valley 360 (the editorial site) and Catskill Daily Mail (the legal-notice publication) BOTH route their legal-notice intake through Column subdomains. The editorial public_notices page is a syndicated display layer; the canonical machine-readable source is the Column API. There is NO independent legal-notices RSS/JSON feed at hudsonvalley360.com or catskillnewspapers.com (the latter is DNS-unresolvable from this sandbox; may be inactive or merged into Daily Gazette).

reachability.js_required: yes for the website's notices display layer (likely loads from Column API client-side)

channels.distress_doc_types_carried: same as Column (foreclosure sale, notice of sale, summons, probate, etc.)
channels.value_assessment: Display-layer only — DO NOT scrape hudsonvalley360.com or dailygazette.com for notices. Hit the Column API directly with the corrected filter.

channels.name: catskillnewspapers.com (legacy Daily Mail/Register Star portal)
channels.rationale: DNS-unresolvable in audit sandbox and HTTP-526 via WebFetch. Likely deprecated / migrated into the Daily Gazette / Hudson Valley 360 / Column stack.
channels.recommendation: Skip. Treat as superseded by Column subdomains.

channels.name: Greenville Pioneer (small Greene County weekly)
channels.rationale: Small local paper, not the designated newspaper of record. Not observed publishing distress notices via web. Site at greenvillepioneer.com / www.greenvillepioneer.com is HTTP-526 / origin-unreachable from audit infrastructure. /legal-notices path also unreachable.
channels.recommendation: De-prioritize. If Phase-4 needs maximum coverage, manually verify by phoning the paper; otherwise skip.

channels.name: nyspublicnotices.com  (alleged NYNPA statewide aggregator)
channels.rationale: Domain does not resolve from the audit infrastructure (both direct curl and WebFetch ECONNREFUSED / 404). NYNPA member site at nynpa.com is reachable but does not surface a notices feed. The state-newspaper-association aggregator referenced in older recon notes may be defunct or rebranded under Column.
channels.nynpa_landing: https://www.nynpa.com/  (alive, no machine-readable notices feed exposed; member-services brochureware)
channels.recommendation: Do NOT depend on this aggregator. The NY public-notice ecosystem has consolidated onto Column for most member papers.

channels.name: mypublicnotices.com (national aggregator)
channels.rationale: WebFetch timeouts and 404s on common search paths. Not a primary venue for NY notices; NY participation appears limited.

channels.name: Greene County Clerk department page
channels.rationale: County Clerk page documents recording / DMV / passport services; does NOT publish legal notices itself. Directs to county /category/notices/ for postings.
channels.recommendation: Skip for distress-event recon. (Recorded foreclosure judgments and lis pendens flow through the Clerk's recording system but appear as PRIVATE PERSON SEARCHES via IQS/Cott — separate channel, not relevant to legal-notice publication.)

ranked_channel_priority_for_distress_rec.fix_required: change adapter filter from 'Greene' to 'Greene County' (or drop filter and key on newspapername+text)
OCR pipeline (pdftotext returns 0 — scanned PDF). Use tesseract or AWS Textract.
do not scrape; hit Column directly

smoking_gun_evidence.summary: Column adapter filter value 'Greene' returns 76 mis-tagged Kingston Daily Freeman notices with ZERO Greene-property markers. Filter value 'Greene County' returns 35 Catskill Daily Mail distress notices in the same window. One-character fix lifts yield 35x.

q1.result: 76 results, all from Kingston Daily Freeman, 0 with Greene-property markers

q2.result: 35 results, all from Catskill Daily Mail, noticetypes={Foreclosure Sale: 30, Summons: 4, Estate (Probate) Filings: 1}

q3.filter: newspapername=['Catskill Daily Mail'], state='New York', 90d, no search
q3.result: 200 total notices, county field uniformly 'Greene County', 17 distress-keyword text matches

q4.result: Multi-county tags observed in raw data: 'Albany County, Greene County' for Ravena News-Herald — county field is a comma-joined string for multi-service papers

official_primary_event_sources: column_enotice (foreclosure sale, notice of sale, summons, probate)

remediation_actions_when_build_resumes: 1) Patch scrapers/legal_notices_column.py PUBLISHING_COUNTIES to use the canonical Column tag values: replace 'Greene' with 'Greene County' (and 'Albany' -> 'Albany County', etc.). Or refactor to filter on newspapername + text-based property attachment. Verify by re-running with --days-back 90 and expecting ~35 distress notices.

2) Use Column's noticetype field as the primary classifier: 'Foreclosure Sale', 'Notice of Sale', 'Summons', 'Estate (Probate) Filings'. Adapter currently re-derives via regex DISTRESS_PATTERNS which costs accuracy.

3) Build an OCR adapter for the Treasurer's annual Petition and Notice of Foreclosure PDF. Path: greenecountyny.gov/wp-content/uploads/YYYY/04/YYYY-Petition-and-Notice-of-Forclosure.pdf (note the misspelling 'Forclosure'). pdftotext returns 0 bytes; needs tesseract/Textract.
4) Add a /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?categories=<notices> tap to the county WordPress site to detect mid-year auction announcements that link to AAR catalogs.
5) Do NOT build adapters for catskillnewspapers.com, greenvillepioneer.com, nyspublicnotices.com, mypublicnotices.com — they are dead or display-layer-only.
6) Do NOT scrape hudsonvalley360.com / dailygazette.com — they re-render Column data client-side.
next_steps_for_operator: Schedule the Column filter fix as a 1-line change with regression test (expected_90d_count >= 25 distress notices). Defer OCR-based Treasurer petition adapter as a separate work item.
